series.nom: Taux combiné des droits antidumping et compensateurs

2020.texte: most companies were subject to the "non-selected" combined cash deposit rate of 8.59% from the third administrative review

2021.texte: the 8.05% "non-selected" rate from the fourth administrative reviews came into effect in August 2023

2022.texte: Companies subject to the fifth administrative review combined "non-selected" rate of 14.40% may receive either a net invoice or a net refund

2023.texte: Since the 35.16% combined final duty rate from the sixth administrative reviews will replace those rates
